maxVersionNote: 0.1.0 reads the type and shape tokens (--ds-weight-*, --ds-btn-radius, --ds-card-radius, --ds-input-radius) and every colour role systems define in src/styles/tokens.css, global.css, blocks/*.css and pages/*.css; src/lib/ds-slot.ts and the layout load data/ds-slot.css as in Tracy Base. NOT YET MEASURED on a built site (see readyNote).
applies: data/ds-slot.css read per request by src/lib/ds-slot.ts; the template reads every value as var(--ds-*, <its own value>)
readsRolesNote: src/styles/tokens.css and global.css read every standard role variable, or declare it unused with a reason (ds-not-used) or keep it (ds-keep); the type and shape tokens are read with the template's own value as the fallback
modesNote: the source has a dark theme (css/darkmode.css, html[data-theme="dark"]) whose tokens read the roles too (src/styles/tokens.css second block); the pre-paint script in Base.astro always sets data-theme (light or dark, from the stored choice, `?theme=` or the OS) so no unmarked state is left. The source renders no switch (docs/design-system.md, DECISIONS D12), so none is drawn; the selector is declared for a switch a customer or a later release adds.

contrast.heading: body :is(h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6)
contrast.text: body :is(p, li, a, span, small, label, td, th, dd, dt, blockquote, figcaption, button)
contrast.block-text: body div:not(:has(> :is(div, p, ul, ol, section, article, header, footer, nav, main, aside, figure, table, form, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6)))
